bug_locations: dependency_order function - nodes collection (missing referenced nodes)
dependency_order function - missing cycle detection (no ValueError raised)
dependency_order function - duplicate-push guard using in_ready set instead of scanning heap list
explanation: Three bugs: (1) `nodes` only included dict keys, missing nodes that appear only as dependency values — fixed by also adding all values into `nodes`. (2) No cycle detection — fixed by checking if `len(out) != len(nodes)` after the loop and raising `ValueError`. (3) The `m not in ready` check scanned the heap list which is unreliable as a membership test when elements could be pushed multiple times — fixed by maintaining a separate `in_ready` set for O(1) duplicate prevention.
